final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS avgratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.insurstat), s2 AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avgratio) AS avg2 FROM s1 GROUP BY insurstat), s3 AS (SELECT s1.zoneref AS zoneref, s1.insurstat AS insurstat, s1.avgratio AS avgratio, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.avgratio - s2.avg2 AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.insurstat = s2.insurstat WHERE s1.avgratio > s2.avg2) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avgratio), COUNT(*), AVG(diff) FROM s3 GROUP BY insurstat
